name: @appfigures/cli
stderr:
Usage: appfigures [options] [command]

Appfigures CLI

Options:
  -v, --verbose         Log HTTP requests to stderr
  -V, --version         output the version number
  -h, --help            display help for command

Commands:
  apps                  (search|get|tracked|breakdown) Find apps and look up
                        their identity. Other commands take the app IDs these
                        return.
  explorer              (list-products|aggregate-products|describe-fields)
                        Search and analyze the full app catalog: millions of
                        products across Apple, Google Play, Amazon, and other
                        major stores, with 120+ fields spanning identity,
                        storefront and country availability, categories,
                        ratings, release dates, chart ranks, download and
                        revenue estimates, SDK presence, demographics, and
                        related apps. Both individual app records and
                        aggregates, not just apps you own.
  metrics               (query|describe-datasets) Query numeric datasets across
                        dimensions. Time-series data lives here: downloads,
                        revenue, ratings over time. `metrics describe-datasets`
                        lists every dataset and which apps it returns data for.
  store                 (app-ranks|top-charts|categories|featured|app-listing)
                        App store presence: listing content, category ranks, top
                        charts, and featured placements. Two rank directions:
                        `store app-ranks` returns an app's ranks, `store
                        top-charts` returns a chart's apps; category IDs are
                        discoverable through `store categories`. Keyword search
                        positions live in `keywords`; identity data (publisher,
                        member products) lives in `apps get`.
  audience              (demographics|cross-usage) Who an app's users are and
                        what else they use. Covers estimated age and gender,
                        plus audience overlap with other apps.
  reviews               (list|breakdown|reply) Search, summarize, and reply to
                        iOS and Google Play app store reviews.
  keywords              (organic|paid|tracked-ranks|tracked-trend|suggestions|ranking-apps|advertisers|related|tracked|track|untrack)
                        Keyword visibility, rank tracking, and discovery across
                        organic search (App Store, Google Play) and Apple Ads.
  apple-ads             (organizations|campaigns|ad-groups|keywords|search-terms|report|top-keywords)
                        Manage your Apple Ads campaigns, ad groups, keywords,
                        and performance. Competitor Apple Ads keyword intel is
                        in `keywords paid` (keywords an app bids on) and
                        `keywords advertisers` (who bids on a term).
  sdks                  (list) Look up the SDKs we track. Useful when filtering
                        by SDKs in `explorer list-products`.
  docs                  (get) Reference docs and guides for specific actions and
                        common tasks.
  auth                  (login|logout|status) Authentication commands
  api [options] <path>  Make a raw API request for endpoints without a dedicated
                        command. Endpoints, parameters, and response shapes are
                        documented at https://docs.appfigures.com.
  mcp                   (Deprecated) Run a local MCP server over stdio. Use the
                        hosted Appfigures MCP server instead:
                        https://mcp.appfigures.com/mcp
  help [command]        display help for command

EXAMPLES
  # List every app you own (apps from store accounts you connected)
  $ appfigures apps tracked --filter-apps-by-source=own

  # Daily downloads for every app you own (last 30 days)
  $ appfigures metrics query sales.combined_download
